review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review; not independent approval)
review.notes: Read-only production evidence is in the project pane-state-diagnosis-20261111 report. Fix display inference without weakening exact identity/turn authorization. A named stale active marker can outlive a later finished cache and get revived by idle terminal redraw. Only current Codex ready/no-work/no-approval evidence plus later finished time may override that obsolete DISPLAY; preserve fresh starts, real work/CPU/queues/approvals, all real markers, and producer completion separation. Use the current work indicator elapsed time when an old active timestamp predates finished; otherwise explicitly mark duration uncertain, with additive since_uncertain consumed across surfaces and legacy fallback unchanged. Resume Save publication becomes atomic and Codex Save/heartbeat share the existing binding lease, keeping unknown/error/foreign ownership conservative. No real session input, restore, permissions, marker edits, runtime restart/deployment or broad cleanup. No claim that a specific real hook/writer was proved responsible. Tests must use isolated HOME and deterministic barriers/pinned descriptors, not sleep races. Keep all prior CET identity/turn assertions unchanged. source tmp estimates256MiB/floor2GiB; builds currently gated by capacity. Follow-up self-review after accurate S cloud failure: CSR001 CPU control exposed the production sampler clearing recent busy evidence on a second poll in the same Unix second. Keep that original failing assertion intact. Add CSR005 before tests, preserve recent valid CPU activity without dividing by zero for repeated same-second observations; missing/stale/rollback/restarted CPU evidence stays conservative and grace still expires. No sleeps, fabricated proc activity or assertion weakening. CPU follow-up review: comparison of cumulative counters must use the same centisecond precision as the persisted sample; harmless floating-point sum noise must not look like a restarted process. Keep the existing repeated-poll target and add a precision-noise observation without changing its assertions or grace.

cases.description: Shared Go radar does not revive a visibly idle Codex from an obsolete active marker
cases.setup: Actual GatherAgents with isolated state, old named active/turn markers, a newer finished cache, missing or malformed resume/frontend, and fresh window activity. No actual pane or transcript body.
cases.action: Gather repeated ready frames/redraw hints, then work/queued/MCP/approval/fresh-start/CPU and no-finish or older-finish controls. Compare state bytes and mtimes before/after.
cases.expected: Only the narrow ready stale-active/newer-finished display becomes idle, keeps the existing finished time, and never mints Latest/Confirmed/CompletionID or clears/rewrites any lifecycle or binding marker. Real visible work, CPU, queues and waits win; fresh start and missing/older/future finished evidence remain conservative. Existing exact-session/home/turn guards are unchanged. Accurate baseline production must fail the false-working target assertion.

cases.description: Current Codex work duration does not reuse a marker predating a finished observation
cases.setup: Actual GatherAgents and agentsJSONBytes with old active timestamp, newer finished observation, current Working elapsed cells and malformed/unknown elapsed variants.
cases.action: Gather and serialize actual working status; compare parsed observed duration, fresh-marker fallback and unknown-duration metadata.
cases.expected: Current work remains working. A superseded start is replaced by bounded recognized TUI elapsed time, or since=0 with since_uncertain=true when not known, never the old multi-hour start/window activity. Original valid marker behavior and wire defaults remain compatible. No lifecycle proof/state mutation or work-start fabrication.

cases.description: Resume publication is atomic and serializes Codex hook writes with frontend owners
cases.setup: Isolated HOME, production Save/Bind/Refresh, incumbent record, pinned original read descriptor and actual existing binding flock lease.
cases.action: Save shorter record and inspect old descriptor/new pathname; hold binding lease during Save/Refresh, release then retry; keep existing frontend ownership tests.
cases.expected: Old descriptor retains complete original JSON and new path contains complete new JSON. Busy lease returns existing ErrLeaseHeld without overwrite or heartbeat publication; released lease allows normal same-owner operation. Refresh legacy-field recovery releases before Bind reacquires. Foreign/newer/reused identities, symlink destinations, write failures and cancellation remain conservative. Exact old Save fails atomic pinned-reader/lease assertions. No unbounded waiting, real config or unique recovery deletion.

cases.description: Mac, Phone/iPad and browser hide only explicitly uncertain state duration
cases.setup: Real Agent/AgentRow and browser row/time rendering with since_uncertain=true, known since, legacy flag absent, idle and working status. CLI consumes the same Go contract.
cases.action: Decode/render unknown and known duration using fixed synthetic clocks; inspect row content and defaults.
cases.expected: Explicit uncertain duration renders no elapsed text even with recent activity fallback. Known duration renders normally; absent flag keeps legacy fallback and all statuses/icons/groups remain unchanged. Both RN shells share AgentRow; Mac/browser use their real data/render path. No actual App launch/device or timing benchmark claim.

cases.description: Repeated status readers in the same second preserve real CPU work without inventing activity
cases.setup: Production PaneCPUWorking with isolated HOME, fixed explicit wall timestamps and monotonically observed cumulative CPU. Original CSR001 CPU gather assertion remains unchanged.
cases.action: Record baseline, real CPU rise, several identical same-second reads, then settled, backward-clock, missing-baseline and counter-reset observations.
cases.expected: Repeated readers preserve the already observed recent active timestamp and working result; do not divide by zero, invent a new rise or extend the four-second grace. Missing/stale baseline, counter reset or backward clock do not grant working. Accurate old sampler must fail the same-second repeated-working assertion; all existing CPU tests and CSR001 remain unchanged.
